searchText: There is a new release of EOF EEST tests - v2.3.0. This is planned to be the last eof-devnet-0 release, from now on we will be moving forward with merging the changes for eof-devnet-1 spec https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/releases/tag/eip7692%40v2.3.0 We encourage teams to still update to this release before working on devnet-1, as it features a lot of new coverage, which would be good to be green before introducing the breaking devnet-1 changes :). Pls report passing of the tests as usual Is there a specific fuzzer application (or flag in the EEST framework) that I can try running our t8n implementation against? I've got a draft of the EIP-7756 tracing ready to go and I am getting seemingly good results from the traces produced when running EOF tests My fuzzer uses the outputs of EEST, not t8n. ah, ok, so is it something that normies can run off the output from `--traces` in EEST? I mainly just want to see if we're formatting the trace fields correctly, etc. Yes, that's typically how I develop tests. my typical test shell script for test development ``` rm -rf debug/besu_dev mkdir debug/besu_dev if [[ $1 =~ 'tests/' ]] then TESTS=${1} shift else TESTS=tests/osaka/eip7692_eof_v1/ fi uv run fill \ --fork=Osaka \ --t8n-dump-dir debug/besu_dev \ -v \ $TESTS \ --evm-bin $HOME/git/shemnon/besu/build/install/besu/bin/evmtool \ --evm-dump-dir debug/besu_dev \ -traces \ --html=debug/besu_dev/report-osaka.html \ > debug/besu_dev/res.txt \ 2> debug/besu_dev/err.txt ```

There is a new release of EOF EEST tests - v2.3.0. This is planned to be the last eof-devnet-0 release, from now on we will be moving forward with merging the changes for eof-devnet-1 spec

https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/releases/tag/eip7692%40v2.3.0

We encourage teams to still update to this release before working on devnet-1, as it features a lot of new coverage, which would be good to be green before introducing the breaking devnet-1 changes :).

Pls report passing of the tests as usual

excerpts.author: acolytec3
excerpts.content: Is there a specific fuzzer application (or flag in the EEST framework) that I can try running our t8n implementation against?  I've got a draft of the EIP-7756 tracing ready to go and I am getting seemingly good results from the traces produced when running EOF tests

excerpts.author: _shemnon
excerpts.content: My fuzzer uses the outputs of EEST, not t8n.

excerpts.author: acolytec3
excerpts.content: ah, ok, so is it something that normies can run off the output from `--traces` in EEST?  I mainly just want to see if we're formatting the trace fields correctly, etc.

excerpts.author: _shemnon
excerpts.content: Yes, that's typically how I develop tests.

excerpts.author: _shemnon
excerpts.content:
my typical test shell script for test development
```
rm -rf debug/besu_dev
mkdir debug/besu_dev

if [[ $1 =~ 'tests/' ]]
then
  TESTS=${1}
  shift
else
  TESTS=tests/osaka/eip7692_eof_v1/
fi

uv run fill \
  --fork=Osaka \
  --t8n-dump-dir  debug/besu_dev \
  -v \
  $TESTS \
  --evm-bin $HOME/git/shemnon/besu/build/install/besu/bin/evmtool  \
  --evm-dump-dir  debug/besu_dev \
  -traces \
  --html=debug/besu_dev/report-osaka.html \
  > debug/besu_dev/res.txt \
  2> debug/besu_dev/err.txt
```
